CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Evictarr** keeps your download clients clean for Sonarr and Radarr.
It removes downloads once they've been imported, clears stalled downloads and failed imports, and blocks releases that contain malware or files you don't want (such as `.arj`, `.lnk`, `.exe`, RARs, ISOs and ROMs), blocklisting them in Sonarr/Radarr so a replacement is searched for. It can also skip samples, and subtitles or extra audio that aren't in your languages. It works with qBittorrent, RDTClient, Deluge, Transmission and SABnzbd, including several at once, and everything is set up in its web UI behind a login.
Evictarr is a maintained fork of [Purgarr](https://github.com/steveharsant/purgarr) by Steve Harsant, carried on while the original is inactive. His history and licence are kept in the repository.
**Support:** please [open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/p1zzm1ssile/Evictarr/issues). Before posting, check **Logs > Issues** in the web UI, and use **Download all logs** to attach them.
Keep Evictarr on your home network. It holds your download clients' passwords and API keys, so it's not meant to be exposed to the internet through a reverse proxy.
